milestones.title: ChatGPT launches
milestones.note: The public chatbot built on GPT-3.5 that brought large language models to the mainstream.
milestones.significance: The moment large language models reached the general public. Everything in this timeline after November 2022 happens in a market ChatGPT created.

provenance.reason: Date confirmed in an archived primary source. A milestone records a dated event, so it carries no specifications.

milestones.title: Bard launches
milestones.note: Google's ChatGPT rival chatbot that brought the company into the consumer AI race.
milestones.significance: Google's first consumer answer to ChatGPT, and the start of the assistant race between the two largest labs.

provenance.reason: Date confirmed in an archived primary source. A milestone records a dated event, so it carries no specifications.

milestones.title: Bard becomes Gemini
milestones.note: Google retired the Bard brand, renamed the assistant Gemini, and shipped it as a mobile app with a paid Advanced tier.
milestones.significance: The point Google stopped positioning its assistant as an experiment and started selling it. Bard had been the reactive answer to ChatGPT; Gemini was the product line it became.

provenance.reason: Date confirmed in an archived primary source captured on the day of the announcement. A milestone records a dated event, so it carries no specifications.

milestones.title: The EU AI Act enters into force
milestones.note: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — the first broad statutory regime for AI systems, including obligations that fall on general-purpose model providers.
milestones.significance: The first time training and releasing a general-purpose model carried statutory duties rather than voluntary commitments. Obligations phase in over years, but this is the date the regime began to exist.

provenance.reason: The regulation was published in the Official Journal on 12 July 2024, and its own Article 113 states that it enters into force on the twentieth day following publication — 1 August 2024. Both facts are in the archived primary source; the date here is their sum, not an estimate.
